research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Doxel is researching systems and methods for evaluating construction of structures by integrating building information modeling data and scheduling data, as described in 'Generating status of construction site based on hierarchical modeling.' Additionally, they are developing methods for tracking progression of a construction site over time using imaging and computer models, as outlined in 'Tracking an ongoing construction by using fiducial markers.' These efforts focus on automating construction progress reporting and site evaluation.

overview_description.description:
Doxel is an AI software solution that automates progress & schedule tracking for all trades using cameras

Using a 360 camera, our AI reports percent complete against schedule and tracks production rates, so you know where the project is and where it’s headed

It was introduced in 2016 and operates in Redwood City, California.

product.name: Automated Progress Tracking
product.description: AI-driven system that uses 360° video and computer vision to measure and compare actual construction progress against plans automatically.

product.name: Systems View
product.description: Feature providing detailed, system-level progress tracking within trades, enabling monitoring of specific construction systems beyond general trade-level data.

product.name: Integration with BIM and Scheduling Software
product.description: Capability to integrate BIM models and project schedules to visualize and compare planned versus actual construction progress.

product.description: Services that handle project onboarding, model organization, data processing, and reporting to support construction progress tracking implementation.
